tips.text: Hit lone targets with Taste Their Fear; it deals far more damage to enemies away from their allies. Wait for a straggler before you jump in.
Fight away from enemy minions, champions and turrets so your target stays isolated and your damage stays high.
Start fights from a brush or after Void Assault, then attack first; Unseen Threat adds damage and slows the target.
Use Leap to close the gap, and cast Taste Their Fear while you are still in the air.
Fire Void Spike with yourself inside the blast to heal. Use it when you are hurt, such as after a camp or a trade.
Don't dive when Leap and Void Assault are on cooldown; you have no way out and you are easy to catch.
Pick off the enemy's lone target, then reset Leap by scoring a takedown once it is evolved. Chain kills when the enemy team splits up.

combos.name: Leap into buffered Q
combos.when: Gap-closing onto an isolated target that is out of Taste Their Fear range.
combos.text: Cast Taste Their Fear while still mid-leap and it buffers to fire as soon as you land. The wiki notes it can be cast during the dash.

combos.name: Flash during Leap
combos.when: The target is just beyond your Leap range and you want to close the gap.
combos.text: The wiki notes that summoner spells can be used while leaping. Flash mid-leap to extend your reach, then slash with Taste Their Fear.

tips.text: Look for Aatrox when he is away from minions and allies, then hit him with Taste Their Fear for its big bonus damage.
Step out of Infernal Chains sideways or toward Aatrox, or Leap out of them. If you stay inside, you get pulled back and hit again.
Start the fight from stealth. Your first attack from Unseen Threat slows him, which makes The Darkin Blade harder for him to land.
Aatrox's sword swings are telegraphed, so wait for him to use The Darkin Blade, dodge it, then jump in while it is on cooldown.
Don't stay in a long fight with Aatrox. He heals from damage he deals, so burst him and leave, or finish him with Void Assault.
Hunt Ambessa when she is alone: Taste Their Fear hits an isolated target much harder, so look for her away from minions and allies.
Start fights from stealth. Use Void Assault so your next attack slows her, which makes it hard for her to catch you or close in.
Don't stand in front of her when Public Execution is ready. She can blink to the farthest enemy champion and then stun them, so stay near allies.
Leap in after she has spent Lacerate or Cunning Sweep. Her abilities have cooldowns, and a Leap landing on her then is hard to punish.
Fire Void Spike at her from a distance to poke and heal, and don't walk into her when she is bracing with Repudiation.
Do not walk alone through the jungle. Amumu can hit you with Bandage Toss from far away and his team will follow up.
Keep Leap ready when Amumu has his ultimate. Jump away from his team before Curse of the Sad Mummy can catch you.
Aim Taste Their Fear at Amumu's teammates when they are isolated. Amumu is a poor target because he is tanky.
Use Void Assault to hide and escape when Amumu's Bandage Toss is down. You can then attack when he is not looking.
Look for Bel'Veth when she is Isolated from her allies and hit her with Taste Their Fear for its much bigger damage.
Use Leap to jump in after she has spent Above and Below, then finish with Taste Their Fear.
Fight early. Bel'Veth gets stronger with every takedown, so cut her scaling short by ganking and invading before she snowballs.
Stay out of her view, then start the fight with an attack that has Unseen Threat to slow her.
Don't stay next to her while Royal Maelstrom is up. She takes less damage and heals while it lasts, so back off or wait it out.
Look for Brand when he is far from his allies. Taste Their Fear hits an isolated target much harder.
Dodge Sear and Pillar of Flame. Brand needs to land a spell to start his combo, and the stun only comes with fire already on you.
Use Leap to get out of Pillar of Flame, which lands after a short delay. Move before it erupts.
Move away from your allies when Brand casts Pyroclasm. The missile starts slowly, so you have time to spread out.
Hit Briar with Taste Their Fear when she is away from minions and allies; it does far more damage to an isolated target.
Open from the brush or with Void Assault so Unseen Threat is ready, then attack her for bonus damage and a slow.
Briar heals from her bleed, so burst her quickly with Leap and Taste Their Fear instead of trading slowly.
Keep Leap ready when Briar is near. After she uses Blood Frenzy you can jump away, since Void Assault is long to come back.
Use Void Spike on her when she charges in; it heals you if you stand in the blast.
Look for Darius when he is far from his minions and allies; Taste Their Fear hits an isolated target much harder.
Wait until Apprehend is on cooldown before you jump in. Without the pull he has a hard time catching you.
Hit Darius from range with Void Spike, then back off. Do not stand and trade, since his stacking bleed makes long fights go his way.
Use Leap to get away once Darius has landed Decimate or Apprehend. Void Assault gives you a second escape.
Come out of stealth with your Unseen Threat attack on Darius. It slows him, so he has a harder time hitting you with Decimate.
Fight Diana when she is alone; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on an isolated target, so wait until her allies step away.
Slip into brush or use Void Assault before you start the fight, then hit her with an attack so Unseen Threat slows her.
Save Leap for after Diana has used Lunar Rush. Without it she has a harder time getting away from you or following you.
Stay out of the way of Moonfall in a team fight. It pulls you in, and the beam lands after a short delay, so spread out from your allies.
Look for Mundo when he is alone, then open with Taste Their Fear for the big isolated damage.
Don't try to burst Mundo through Maximum Dosage; he heals through slow damage, so kill him before he uses it or leave.
Dodge Infected Bonesaw by sidestepping; it is a narrow line that stops at the first enemy.
Skip fighting inside Heart Zapper's range; he stores your damage and heals it back on recast.
Use Void Assault to approach unseen, then hit with Unseen Threat to slow Mundo.
Hunt Ekko when he is alone; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on an isolated target, so wait until his allies are away.
Watch for Ekko's trail; when Chronobreak is down, he is much weaker, so that is the time to commit to a kill.
Don't chase Ekko into a fight he can rewind out of; after he uses Chronobreak, he is easier to finish.
Stay out of the Parallel Convergence circle. If you are caught in it you are stunned, so use Leap to get out early.
Step out of the Timewinder field fast; the return hit does more damage than the first.
Start fights from stealth with Void Assault, then hit Ekko with a basic attack to slow him with Unseen Threat.
Catch Evelynn away from her minions and allies, then use Taste Their Fear; it hurts far more against isolated targets.
If Evelynn marks you with Allure, move toward allies or away from her; the mark takes time to ripen before it charms.
Keep Leap ready as an escape when Evelynn comes for you; you are weak while it is on cooldown.
Don't fight Evelynn when you are low; Last Caress deals much more damage to low-health targets.
Look for Fiddlesticks when he is alone, then hit him with Taste Their Fear for big damage.
Do not walk into dark brush or fog next to a still scarecrow; Fiddlesticks can pretend to be an effigy and fear you with Terrify.
Leave Bountiful Harvest early: do not stand in its range for long, since it drains and heals him.
Save Leap to get out of Reap's slow, or to close in when he is isolated.
Void Assault gives you Unseen Threat and hides you; use it to approach, then attack first.
Hunt Graves when he is isolated. Taste Their Fear deals far more damage to him when he has no allies close.
Step out of Smoke Screen quickly. Leaving the cloud removes its harmful effect straight away.
Don't Leap in while Quickdraw is ready. Graves can dash away and shoot back with a point-blank blast.
Use Void Assault to vanish and reset Unseen Threat, then hit Graves with an empowered attack to slow him.
Don't stand in a straight line from Graves at level 6. Collateral Damage hurts a lot.
Look for Gwen when she is away from her minions and allies, then use Taste Their Fear for its big bonus damage against Isolated targets.
Don't waste Void Spike or Taste Their Fear while Gwen's Hallowed Mist is up and you stand outside it; she can't be targeted, so wait for it to end.
Hit Gwen's first attack from stealth with Unseen Threat to slow her, then burst her before she sets up her stacks.
Keep Leap ready as your way out. Gwen's Needlework slows you and hurts a lot if she gets all her casts.
Look for Hecarim when he is alone; Taste Their Fear then hits much harder and you can finish him.
Don't stay in range of Spirit of Dread; it heals him as he damages you.
Spread away from your allies when Hecarim has Onslaught of Shadows ready, so one fear doesn't catch everyone.
Keep Leap ready to escape when Hecarim charges in with Devastating Charge.
Hunt Ivern when he is away from Daisy and his allies; Taste Their Fear hits an isolated Ivern much harder.
Wait until Rootcaller is on cooldown before you jump in. Getting rooted next to Ivern's team is deadly.
Be careful fighting Ivern when Daisy is up. Her third hit on you knocks you up, so kill Ivern fast or fight away from her.
Ivern's brush lasts a long time, so check it before you walk in. Use Void Assault to get Unseen Threat back after you leave sight.
Look for Jarvan when he is alone. Taste Their Fear does huge damage to an Isolated target.
Do not Leap in when Jarvan's Cataclysm is ready. He can trap you in terrain with him.
Stay out of the line between Jarvan and his Demacian Standard, or you get knocked up.
Use Void Assault to vanish and reset Unseen Threat before you start a fight. The first attack slows Jarvan.
Hit Jax with Taste Their Fear only when he is isolated from his allies and minions, since it does the most damage then.
Wait out Counter Strike before you attack Jax. He dodges attacks while it lasts, then stuns anyone close.
Don't trade long attack-for-attack with Jax. Open with Void Spike from range, then step back before his attack speed builds.
Keep Leap or Void Assault ready to get away from Jax; he can chase you down with Leap Strike.
Hunt Jayce when he is alone: Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target, so wait until he is away from minions and allies.
Wait in the brush or use Void Assault before you jump him, so your next attack slows him with Unseen Threat and he can't kite away.
Use Leap to close the gap when Jayce is in Cannon Stance, because his range is long. Once you are on him, keep attacking and don't back off.
Void Spike is a good poke from range, and it heals you if you stand in the blast. Use it to get Jayce's health down before you commit.
Hit Karthus with Taste Their Fear when he is alone. It deals far more damage to isolated targets.
Don't walk through Wall of Pain. It slows you and lowers your Magic Resist, so go around it or wait for it to expire.
Karthus is weak up close, so use Leap to jump in on him. Then run out before Defile and Lay Waste wear you down.
Kill Karthus, then move away from his corpse. Death Defied lets him keep casting for a few seconds.
Stay healthy after level 6. Requiem hits you from anywhere, and its light shows you when he starts channeling.
Fight Kayn when he is alone. Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target, so pick fights away from his camps' allies and minions.
Start fights from stealth. Void Assault gives Unseen Threat, so your first attack slows Kayn and he cannot easily run.
Hit Kayn with Void Spike when he is in the wall. Damage shortens Shadow Step, and the spike also heals you if you stand in the blast.
Keep Leap ready for when Kayn tries to escape or start a fight. Use it to close the gap and finish him.
Catch Kindred alone and hit her with Taste Their Fear; it deals far more damage to an isolated target, and she is fragile.
Do not trap Kindred inside Lamb's Respite. Nobody can die in it, so wait for it to end before you commit.
Start fights from the brush or after Void Assault so your next attack slows her and she cannot kite away.
Jump on Kindred when Dance of Arrows is on cooldown, because she then has little to escape with.
Kill Kindred's Wolf's Frenzy camp targets before she does; this slows her growth. Fight her outside the Wolf's zone.
Look for Lee Sin when he is away from his minions or allies. Taste Their Fear hits an Isolated target much harder.
Save Leap to dodge or escape after Lee Sin uses Sonic Wave. Without it you are easy to catch.
Lee Sin shrugs off physical damage with Iron Will, but Unseen Threat deals magic damage, so use it to open the fight.
Use Void Assault to disappear before Lee Sin's Dragon's Rage. He needs a target to kick.
Use Taste Their Fear when Lillia is isolated from her allies and minions; it hits far harder then.
Dodge Swirlseed, then jump in with Leap, because it slows and reveals you if it lands.
Do not fight in a Lillia fight when she has Lilting Lullaby ready at level 6 and your Dream Dust is on you; sleep means a free kill for her.
Hit Lillia from the brush to get Unseen Threat's bonus damage and slow, which also stops her from running away.
Step out of the centre of her big ground smash when you see her wind up; the middle hits much harder than the edge.
Look for Master Yi when he is alone and use Taste Their Fear on him for its big bonus damage.
Do not rely on slows once Master Yi has Highlander running. Fight him before he uses it, or save your burst.
Do not walk away while Master Yi has Alpha Strike ready; he cannot be targeted during it, so save Leap to escape after he lands.
Strike hard before Meditate starts. Hit him a few times so he has to spend mana healing.
Find Wukong alone and hit him with Taste Their Fear; it does far more damage to isolated targets.
After Wukong uses Nimbus Strike, wait a moment before attacking, since the clone from Warrior Trickster may be what you see.
Don't stand in Cyclone; it knocks you up and hurts. Keep Leap ready to jump out.
End long fights early; Wukong gets tougher the longer he keeps hitting you.
Hunt Naafiri when she is isolated from her allies; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on a lone target.
Wait until The Call of the Pack has ended before you commit, because she cannot be targeted while it starts.
Void Spike works well from range; it keeps going after hitting, so use it to start a fight or finish a runner.
Use Void Assault before you engage so your first attack applies Unseen Threat and slows her.
Hunt for Nidalee when she is away from her minions or allies; Taste Their Fear then deals much more damage.
Dodge her Javelin Toss, especially from far away. A hit marks you as Hunted and sets up her cougar attacks.
Her Bushwhack traps are invisible, so be careful walking through brush and choke points she may have trapped.
Keep Leap ready for when she jumps on you in cougar form; it lets you get away or reposition.
Use Void Spike on her to get a slow and some healing once evolved; it helps you catch her.
Look for Nocturne when you are alone and low on health. Unspeakable Horror plus Paranoia can catch you from far away.
Leap away to break the tether of Unspeakable Horror before the fear lands.
Bait Shroud of Darkness with a cheap Void Spike first, then go in with Taste Their Fear once the barrier is gone.
Do not fight Nocturne while his Umbra Blades is ready; the attack hits for a lot and heals him. Trade when it is on cooldown.
Look for Nunu & Willump when they are alone. Taste Their Fear does far more damage to an isolated target.
Don't fight inside Absolute Zero. Use Leap or Void Assault to get out before the slow builds up.
Sidestep Biggest Snowball Ever! with a sharp turn instead of running in a straight line.
Don't stay near Nunu & Willump after Snowball Barrage hits you. Move away before the root lands.
Open from out of sight so Unseen Threat's attack slows them. Then jump in with Leap and finish with Taste Their Fear.
Hit isolated targets with Taste Their Fear for big damage. Catch Pantheon away from his allies.
Do not jump in with Leap while Shield Vault is ready; Pantheon will stun you.
Do not attack Pantheon head-on while he braces with Aegis Assault. Wait it out or hit him from the side.
Stay healthy near Pantheon; a thrown Comet Spear kills low-health targets.
Move away when Grand Starfall is announced; it gives warning before he lands.
Hunt Qiyana when she is alone; Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target, so look for her away from minions and allies.
Hold Leap for when Qiyana uses her dash. Without it you can't easily catch her or get away from her.
Stay out of sight before you jump her, then hit her with an attack first so Unseen Threat slows her.
Void Assault gives you a cloaked approach to start a fight and also a way to get out after trading.
Look for Rammus when he is alone; Taste Their Fear on an isolated target hits much harder.
Avoid basic attacks into Rammus while Defensive Ball Curl is up; it hurts you and he is very tanky then. Wait for it to end, or fight with abilities.
Do not walk up to Rammus when Frenzying Taunt is ready; you cannot act while taunted. Keep your distance and keep Leap for escaping.
Fire Void Spike from range while Rammus is out of Defensive Ball Curl, since he is much weaker then.
Step aside from a rolling Powerball, or Leap away early; being hit leaves you knocked back and slowed.
Stay out of Rek'Sai's reach when you walk around unseen; her Burrow reveals moving enemies nearby, so stand still or go around instead of walking up to her.
Hit Rek'Sai with Taste Their Fear when she is away from her minions and allies; she takes much more damage while isolated.
Don't trade when her Fury is full, because Furious Bite then turns into true damage. Pick your fight after she has spent it.
Keep Leap ready to get away when she is near. Rek'Sai's Void Rush can't be dodged by stunning her, so don't count on stopping it.
Void Assault gives you Unseen Threat even if she sees you. Use it to slow her with your next attack and to leave when a fight turns.
Don't fight Rengar near brush; his passive lets him leap onto you from it.
Engage when Rengar's Ferocity is low; his empowered abilities are what beat you in a trade.
Dodge Bola Strike; it slows you, or roots you when empowered, and that lets him catch you.
Take your Taste Their Fear fights when Rengar is isolated from his minions and allies; the damage is much higher then.
When you see the mark over you from Thrill of the Hunt, Rengar is close and about to jump you. Move toward allies.
Void Spike heals you only if you stand in its blast, so hit Rengar up close for the heal.
Look for Sejuani when she is far from her team. Taste Their Fear deals big damage to isolated targets, but she is tanky and hard to burst.
Do not walk into Glacial Prison. Jump around the bola's line, because a stun in a fight with her team is deadly.
Hold Leap until Sejuani has used Arctic Assault. Without it she can't easily chase you down.
Do not fight Sejuani beside her melee allies. They stack Permafrost for her, and it ends in a stun.
Walk carefully through brush and choke points; Shaco's Jack In The Box is hidden and will fear and root you.
Void Spike can break the box's hiding place only if it is revealed; use Void Assault's invisibility to scout less and keep your distance from his traps.
Once Shaco uses Deceive to jump in, he cannot quickly vanish again; fight him then with Taste Their Fear.
Keep Leap ready as an escape when Shaco turns invisible; he is very hard to fight from behind.
Hit Shyvana with Taste Their Fear only when she is away from her allies, so you get the big damage.
Do not fight Shyvana toe-to-toe; her Inferno Aegis shield and Emberstrike make a long brawl bad for you.
Poke her with Void Spike while her Dragon Fury is low; she is weak when kept at a distance.
Do not hit her while Inferno Aegis is on; wait for the shield to break or pop, then burst her.
Look for enemies who are alone and open with Taste Their Fear; it hits much harder on an isolated target.
Do not fight Skarner when Ixtal's Impact is ready. If he grabs you, you are carried until you hit a wall and get stunned.
Keep Leap for escaping after a trade; Skarner is much harder to fight with it on cooldown.
Don't ignore Skarner's sustained damage. Hit and back off rather than standing and trading, because his Quaking builds up.
Step out of the way of Impale, and use Void Assault to turn invisible if he is about to cast it.
Jump on Sylas when he is away from his minions and allies; Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target.
Wait until Sylas has spent Abscond / Abduct before you leap in, because he can use it to dash away or pull himself onto you.
Hit Sylas with Void Spike when you are close, so you heal while you damage him.
Do not trade into a Sylas who is low on health; Kingslayer heals him back up.
Stay hidden before you engage so Unseen Threat makes your first attack hurt and slow him.
Look for Talon when he is alone. Taste Their Fear deals far more damage to an isolated target.
Don't stand in a line with Talon's Rake. Step aside, because the blades also come back and slow you.
Fight Talon while Shadow Assault is on cooldown. Without it he can't escape or finish a fight as easily.
Break the fight early when Talon has hit you with several abilities. One more attack makes Blade's End bleed you for heavy damage.
Use Void Assault to go invisible and set up Unseen Threat before you fight Talon. It adds damage and a slow to your first attack.
Catch Trundle away from his team and his Frozen Domain; Taste Their Fear deals much more to an isolated target.
Don't fight Trundle inside his Frozen Domain; he is faster and hits harder there.
Get out of Pillar of Ice quickly, since it slows you; don't leap toward it blindly.
Kill Trundle's allies or minions first when you can; his King's Tribute heals him when enemies die near him.
Void Assault lets you reset Unseen Threat and escape; use it to disengage once Trundle uses Subjugate on you.
Hunt Udyr when he is alone; Taste Their Fear deals far more damage to isolated targets.
Do not jump in while Udyr has Blazing Stampede ready; his next attack dashes onto you and stuns you.
Keep Leap ready as your escape if Udyr turns on you, since he is a sturdy fighter who wins long brawls.
Fire Void Spike at Udyr from range to heal yourself; Udyr has few ranged options.
Pick fights when Vi is isolated from her allies; Taste Their Fear hits far harder on a lone target.
Don't stand and trade basic attacks with Vi. Her third hit on you shreds your Armor and speeds her up.
Stay out of sight, then open with your empowered basic attack from Unseen Threat to slow Vi so she can't easily catch you.
Vi's Cease and Desist can't be stopped once it starts. Don't waste Leap on dodging it; save it to get away after she lands.
Leap away or sidestep when you see Vi charging Vault Breaker; a full charge hurts a lot.
Fight Viego when he is away from his minions and allies; Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target.
Use Void Assault before you attack him; it hides you and gives Unseen Threat, so your first hit slows him.
Do not finish a kill that Viego can reach. He can eat the wraith and take the dead champion's form, so avoid fighting near a fresh kill.
Aim Void Spike so you stay out of the way of Spectral Maw; a fully charged one stuns for a long time. Leap away if you see him charging.
Look for targets who wander away from allies and open with Taste Their Fear. It does much more damage to isolated enemies.
Do not attack Volibear while Thundering Smash is ready. His next attack stuns you.
Keep Leap ready as your escape. Volibear's Frenzied Maul heals him in a long trade, so do not stay and fight him.
Hit Volibear with Void Spike from range when he is not near you, and step out of the Sky Splitter area when you see him cast it.
Hit Warwick when he is away from his allies and minions. Taste Their Fear deals far more damage to an isolated target.
Leap away from Warwick only when you must. He can hold Jaws of the Beast to follow you through it, so do not rely on one jump to escape.
Do not fight Warwick when you are low. Blood Hunt lets him track you and chase faster, and his attacks heal him when he is low.
Stay out of his Infinite Duress range when you are low. He leaps very far, and the suppression stops you from using any escape.
Fight Warwick when Primal Howl is on cooldown. Without it he takes more damage and cannot fear you away.
Look for Xin Zhao when he is away from his minions and allies, then hit him with Taste Their Fear for its big isolated damage.
Do not fight Xin Zhao head-on once he has Audacious Charge and Crescent Guard ready. Wait until they are on cooldown.
Use Leap to get away from Xin Zhao, since he can slow you with Wind Becomes Lightning and chase you down with Audacious Charge.
Keep Void Spike for when Xin Zhao is close so it heals you too. Fighting inside its area gives you a sustain edge.
Stay away from Zac's goo chunks; if you hit him, don't stand on them. Enemy champions crush them, so fight where he cannot reach them.
Hold Leap when Zac is close to charging Elastic Slingshot; use it to get out once he is committed, or to chase him when he lands.
Attack Zac when his allies are far away; Taste Their Fear hits much harder on an isolated target.
Finish off every bloblet when Zac splits, or he comes back. Void Spike can hit several of them at once.
Keep your distance when Stretching Strikes is ready; it can pull you in and leave you stunned next to him.
Look for Zed when he is away from his minions and allies, then hit him with Taste Their Fear; it deals far more damage to an isolated target.
Wait until Zed has used Living Shadow before you jump in. His slow and damage depend on it, and it is on a long cooldown.
Use Void Assault to vanish and then attack Zed. Unseen Threat makes your next basic attack hit harder and slow him.
Keep Leap ready to get away after Zed uses Death Mark on you. Do not waste it when you do not need it.
Void Spike can heal you if you stand inside its blast. Use it in a trade to keep your health up against Zed's Razor Shuriken.
Look for Zyra when she is away from her plants and allies, then use Taste Their Fear for its big bonus damage on an isolated target.
Leap in from the brush or after Void Assault, and attack right away so Unseen Threat slows her.
Zyra's seeds reveal you if you step on them. Walk around visible seeds before you go in, so you keep your ambush.
Fight when Grasping Roots is on cooldown. Being rooted in the open is how she kills you.
Her plants are weak without seeds. Pull the fight to a spot with no seeds or leave early, so she gets no Thorn Spitters or Vine Lashers.
Don't stay inside Stranglethorns when she casts it. Leap out before it snaps up and knocks you up.
